But qualified immunity allows them to react and do their job without fearing to lose their house and their car and all their savings if they acted responsibly within their training and certainly within the law. have broken the law like we have seen, then they will suffer the consequence. But qualified immunity says if you reasonably thought that you or someone else's life or safety was threatened, if you use reasonable force to protect them, then you personally wouldn't be liable for acting in what you thought was the best interest at that time. Now that doesn't mean that the person involved with law enforcement that feels that they were unduly treated wouldn't have recourse against the city or the county or the agency.
